title: Preserve Windows export benchmark receipts and measure the pinned comparison
body:
PR6204's benchmark calls `os.getloadavg()` after all90 measurements and before saving the receipt. Windows lacks that API, so optional telemetry discards an otherwise completed comparison. This package provides a portable entry point around its byte-identical measurement functions, recording unavailable load explicitly while preserving available values and propagating unexpected errors.

The same primary archive and exact old/candidate CLI pair were measured once on native Windows11/CPython3.12.11: all90 commands pass, complete outputs agree, and every sample is retained. Median complete-command time is158.617000→150.552200ms, an observed5.08445% reduction; all9 paired batch medians favor the candidate. This corroborates Nick Petalas's exporter change on this host, not a portable speedup or a new optimization by this contribution.

Evidence includes the frozen529-file/13,701,120-byte archive hash, raw9×5 observations per side, source hashes, native environment metadata,10 reporting/order control groups and10 exact-reason receipt-corruption controls. Registered normal/-O checks, metadata and14-file committed-byte/source-history validation pass. The controls reproduce the original late failure with a simulated completed result; those simulations are separate from the real90 commands. The initial sandboxTEMP and cross-host LF/CRLF validation issues and their corrections are recorded. No timed rerun occurred.

Only `research/windows-export-benchmark/` is added; the shared exporter and frozen predecessor files are unchanged. Exact source6204 is `9889f94b6ed045c1069b2e6f7e4471d0322f2f16`; an ancestry-only local merge retains its objects without importing its shared-code tree. Base main remains `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, revision8, selected#6030. No upstream PR merge/closure or frontier change.

Canonical claim/finding: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19284816. The fixed protocol was posted before execution. Results apply to this desktop/storage/workload; background load was not controlled. Linux, the secondary workload, mathematical verifiers, scientific supplier acceptance, hostedCI and human/kernel review remain unrun or unclaimed. No new kappa.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR6204, Tekalign/PR3138, Ali Romman, roger-sato, Mihir Srivastava, josecarlosgonzalezroque-design, Douglas Colkitt and the retained exporter/Git-reader lineage. AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including parallel wrapper/control work and root review. Apache-2.0.

Reproduce controls and retained-receipt validation without retiming: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/windows-export-benchmark`. The README gives a separate explicit command for a new host measurement.

Final overlap:358 open PRs at04:17UTC,5978 Discussion records at04:22UTC and the complete HEAD note inventory. A transient Discussion-read failure was retried successfully; no competing repair was identified in this bounded coverage.
